        self.graph[to].append(self._Edge(fr, len(self.graph[fr]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return m

            self.fr = fr
            self.to = to
            self.cap = cap
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

        e = self.graph[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
        re = self.graph[e.to][e.rev]
        return self.Edge(self.pos[i][0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost)

    def edges(self):
        res = []
        for i in range(len(self.pos)):
            e = self.graph[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
            re = self.graph[e.to][e.rev]
            res.append(self.Edge(self.pos[i][0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost))
        return res

        dist = [INF] * self.n
        pv = [-1] * self.n
        pe = [-1] * self.n
        vis = [False] * self.n
        dist[s] = 0
        pq = [(0, s)]
        while pq:
            d, v = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if vis[v]:
                continue
            vis[v] = True
            if v == t:
                break
            for i, e in enumerate(self.graph[v]):
                if vis[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                cost = e.cost - self.dual[e.to] + self.dual[v]
                nd = d + cost
                if dist[e.to] > nd:
                    dist[e.to] = nd
                    pv[e.to] = v
                    pe[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, e.to))
        if not vis[t]:
            return False
        for v in range(self.n):

                self.dual[v] -= dist[t] - dist[v]
        return True
